reference.title: CIS recommendation reference topic template
reference.shortdesc: Template for generated and reviewed CIS Settings Guide recommendation topics.

section.title: Disclaimer and scope
section.p: BPM is an independent implementation and is not authorized, sponsored, endorsed, certified, or approved by CIS. BPM documentation is not a substitute for the official CIS benchmark. BPM output does not prove CIS compliance.

The official CIS PDF and source expression are not copied, translated, indexed, or packaged. BPM documents its own mappings, generated layers, merge behavior, manual-review states, and limitations in original prose.

section.title: Benchmark and version
section.p: Identify the benchmark name, version, release date, license boundary, official-source requirement, and tested Firefox baseline used to frame the BPM mapping.

section.title: Recommendation identity
section.p: Record the recommendation ID, level, scored state, source section, source title hash, publication disposition, and provenance record.

section.title: BPM-authored rationale summary
section.p: Summarize the BPM-maintained mapping intent, confidence, mapping status, review notes, and non-publishable reason when a recommendation remains provenance-only.

section.title: BPM mapping
section.p: List each policy or managed-preference target, affected path, value or lock state, Release/ESR support, merge rule, and link to the Firefox policy reference.

section.title: Automation and manual state
section.p: Explain whether BPM configures the recommendation automatically, which generated layers include it, and which paths require manual review.

section.title: Conflicts and exceptions
section.p: Describe preset and layer merge outcomes, stricter-base decisions, manual-review-kept-base decisions, and the 0.9.0 boundary that BPM has no separate persisted CIS exception or waiver model.

section.title: Verification
section.p: Point readers to BPM validation, health or export checks, exported policy paths, independent runtime verification, and any manual action required outside BPM.

section.title: Provenance
section.p: Record the source family, license, publication policy, recommendation source hash, and no-certification notice without publishing restricted benchmark expression.
